home.title: Sentra

timeNoticed.label: When did the symptoms start?
timeNoticed.hint: Paramedics need this time. Pick your best guess.

voice.welcome: Welcome to Sentra. If you think someone is having a stroke, call 911 now. You can also tap Start check.

home.disclaimer: Sentra is a prototype for demonstration only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose stroke. Commercial use would require clinical validation and FDA review.
home.headline: A quick stroke check.

camera.label: Camera view
camera.denied: We can't use the camera. You can skip this check. If you noticed sudden symptoms, call 911.
camera.unsupported: This browser can't use the camera. You can skip this check. If you noticed sudden symptoms, call 911.

face.title: Face check
face.instructions: Look at the camera and smile big. We'll check if one side of the face droops.
face.headline: Look at the camera

arm.title: Arm check
arm.instructions: Hold both arms straight out in front of you, palms up. Keep them there. We'll check if one arm drifts down.
arm.headline: Hold both arms out

speech.title: Speech check
speech.instructions: Ask them to read this sentence out loud:
speech.phrase: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.
speech.noSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Try again, or answer the question below.
speech.unclear: We couldn't get a clear recording. Try again, or answer the question below.
speech.micDenied: We can't use the microphone. Answer the question below instead.
speech.unsupported: This browser can't listen to speech. Answer the question below instead.
speech.disclosure: Speech recognition in Chrome sends audio to Google's servers.
speech.headline: Say this

befast.title: A few quick questions
befast.intro: A few quick questions can catch warning signs the camera can't see. They're optional.
befast.balance: Have they had sudden trouble with balance or coordination?
befast.vision: Have they had sudden vision loss or changes in one or both eyes?
befast.headache: Have they had a sudden severe headache with no known cause?
befast.numbness: Have they had sudden numbness or weakness, especially on one side?

result.call911Line: If you noticed sudden symptoms, call 911.

call911.title: Call 911 now.
call911.body: Warning signs of stroke were found: {reasons}. Note the time symptoms started.

cannotRuleOut.title: We can't rule out a stroke
cannotRuleOut.body: This check cannot rule out a stroke.
cannotRuleOut.recheck: You can run this check again at any time. Don't wait if you have symptoms. Call 911.

retry.title: We couldn't get a clear reading

checkSided.face: uneven face movement on the {side} side
checkSided.arm: weakness or drift in the {side} arm

result.notDiagnosis: This check does not diagnose stroke.

baseline.title: Record a baseline
baseline.intro: Record a short video of your loved one on a typical day. Later, a check can compare against their own usual face and arm movement.
baseline.note: Nothing is uploaded. The recording stays on this device.
baseline.voice: Record a short video on a typical day. It stays on this device and is never uploaded.
